title_zh: 约定先请店员查看玫瑰根系再选盆

scenario.label_zh: 玫瑰盆栽根系查看请求
scenario.goal_zh: 描述盆底根系和阳台光照，决定请工作人员查看后再选购花盆

context_zh: 朋友在园艺店入口查看带来的盆栽与陈列花盆，尚未得到园艺人员意见。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Demi
sentences.text: There is a root sticking out through the hole under this rose. Does it need a bigger pot?

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: I do not know. Let us ask the staff to look before we buy one.

sentences.speaker: Demi
sentences.text: These specially shaped pots would fit along my narrow balcony.

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: Would they leave the plant in the same position?

sentences.speaker: Demi
sentences.text: No. There is much more shade along that wall than where it sits now.

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: Then mention that as well. A pot that fits the space may not solve the problem.

sentences.speaker: Demi
sentences.text: Good point. I'll show the staff the root and explain the light before choosing a pot.
